title: Sentences That Work: Capitals and End Marks
description: Identify complete sentences, correct capitals and end marks, build clear sentences from word cards, and write independently from a picture.
learningFocus: Recognize that a sentence tells a complete idea and begins with a capital letter (RF.1.1(a)).
Capitalize names of people, days, and months, and use commas in complete dates and lists (L.1.2(a), L.1.2(c)).
Use appropriate ending punctuation and construct complete sentences (L.1.2(b)).
adultGuidance: Sentences tell a whole idea. Help your child spot a sentence by asking who or what it is about and what happens. Point to the capital letter at the start and the mark at the end. Let your child fix the capitals and marks, build a sentence from the word cards, and write two sentences about the picture.
